title: Spicy Poblano Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful skewers of marinated chicken, roasted poblano peppers, and onions. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: warmly spiced olive oil
ingredients.notes: or regular olive oil with added cumin and chili powder

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together warmly spiced olive oil, fajita seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken, poblano peppers, and onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
